Subject: Isolated environment activation checklist & short-run smoke plan

Hi Jared / Medicore infra team —

Following our kickoff, attached is the activation checklist we use for isolated/private deployments (lean version for day-1 validation). Please review items below and confirm values where noted so we can schedule the connectivity smoke test next week.

High-level prereqs (please confirm):
- VPC/CIDR: confirm primary CIDR + any secondary ranges (we need 10.10.0.0/16 by default).
- Allowlist: public egress IPs needed for initial pull + telemetry (see attached "medicore-vpc-allowlist.csv") — confirm one admin IP we can open temporarily.
- Service accounts: provide the service account email for RBAC and the KMS principal for disk encryption.
- PKI: if you're using a customer-managed CA, confirm cert chain + rotation window (we support both ACM and self-signed with our PKI guide).
- KMS/HSM: KMS key ARN or Dex/KMS admin contact (we'll need to verify CMK permissions).
- Node sizing: minimum VM/GPU specs and node count for first smoke (we recommend 4x c5.4xlarge or equivalent for baseline).

Short-run smoke plan (day 0–1):
1) Network handshake and ACL validation (30–60m)
2) Private control plane connectivity check (we'll attempt a one-way TLS handshake)
3) Minimal image pull and runtime start (tokenized deployment)
4) Health-check traffic (small synthetic workload)

Action items for Medicore: please reply with the CIDR, admin allowlist IP, service account email, and preferred maintenance windows for next Tue/Wed.

Attachments: activation-checklist.xlsx; network-diagram-v2.png; redwood-private-deploy-pki-instructions.pdf

Thanks — I'll coordinate with Marissa for ops and Ben on access.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin

3) Maintenance window: prefer Tue 10/3 (UTC) or Wed 10/4 morning (UTC). Our devs are in PST so earlier UTC times are fine.

Also attaching our initial allowlist export — the columns show the current proxy and NAT IP ranges we have.

Thanks Jared — good context. Answers inline and proposed next steps: 

PKI: Redwood accepts PEM chains. Rotation is handled by a TTL-aware loader in our runtime; short rotations (weekly) are supported without full downtime as long as both old and new certs are present in the chain for the transition window. We'll share our PKI checklist (see attached PDF) with the exact order.

KMS: Cross-account key policy works best. If you can add a key policy entry that grants encrypt/decrypt to our service principal (redwood-controlplane@redwood-ops), we'll validate keys during the preflight. We'll run a permission check in our staging account and send you the IAM snippet for the policy.

Maintenance windows: Tue 2026-11-03 02:00–06:00 UTC or Wed 2026-11-04 03:00–07:00 UTC are available on our side. Please confirm which block works for you.

Proposed mutual action plan (condensed):
- T-4 days: Medicore provides CIDR, SA email, KMS policy entry + allowlist.
- T-2 days: We run connectivity tests against a read-only endpoint.
- Day 0: Deploy control plane, verify cert chain.
- Day 1: Run synthetic traffic and perf smoke.

Ben/kimberly: Ben will run the one-way handshake; Kimberly will verify telemetry egress and log collection.

Let us know preferred maintenance window and we will schedule the Zoom + runbook review.

— Marissa
